The measure that matters for an archive is not how many pages you saved but how many of them still render. A saved page that depends on a stylesheet from a domain that has since lapsed is a saved page in name only.

This is why localizing assets is not an optimization. It is the difference between an archive and a list of bookmarks with extra steps.
